QuestInfo.name: The Great Masterpiece
QuestInfo.0: You brought the meat and firewood to #p3001002#. What will he make you do now?
QuestInfo.1: This time, #b#p3001002##k wants you to COOK the meat before you bring it to him. As you are thinking about how to cook the meat, you hear a strange animal call coming from #b#m401020100##k. Could it be #b#p3001003##k?
QuestInfo.2: You took #p3001003#'s advice and cooked the meat before you brought it to #p3001002#. Boy did he look satisfied. Maybe NOW you're finally done?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 194,900
Can proceed to the Secret Assembly quest

0.0: Well, well, little would-be guardian. You're tougher than I expected. Those two little tests may seem insignificant alone, but combine them, and you've got a good meal on your hands. \r\n#L0##b(That sounds like an old Nova proverb, but I'm pretty sure he got it wrong...)#l\n#k
0.1: You know what we need? A flavor. Something to bring the meat and wood together into perfect unison.\r\n#L0##bAre you gonna make me cook? #l\n#k
0.2: I just might! Hahaha! The last Kaiser had a real nose for flavor-enhancers. Let's see if you got his gifts!

no.0: Quitting before the cooking starts? You'll go hungry in no time!

1.0: What do you have going on there?\r\n#L0##bUmmm... I have literally never cooked a meal before.#l\n#k
1.1: Just hand it over. I managed to survive the LAST thing you fed me...

yes.0: I don't care how ugly this looks, the real value of food is in the flavor. Here we go!\r\n#b(I hope this doesn't kill him...)#k
yes.1: (You watch as #p3001002# slowly eats the entire meal.) Y-you...\r\n#b(Don't die, don't die, don't die...)#k
yes.2: SPLENDID! The meat is melting in my mouth and there's a hint of hickory in my nostrils! It reminds me of a meal my favorite bawdy lady used to make in the old days!\r\n#b(What the heck is a bawdy lady?)#k
yes.3: Mmm, let me finish this and I'll tell you whatever you want.

item.0: It's not done yet? How well done are you going to get it?!
